title: Karane's Secret Heartache on the Bench — Part 5

series.summary: While the others continue swimming, Karane sits alone on a poolside bench wrapped tightly in a towel, shivering from a mysterious chill. Comparing her flat chest and prickly personality to Hakari and Nano, she drowns in painful self-doubt until Rentaro gently sits down right beside her.

segments.description: Karane sits alone on the bench, hugging her knees inside an oversized bath towel while shivering.
segments.voiceover_text: While everyone else frolics, Karane sits alone on the bench, wrapped tightly in an oversized towel while shivering miserably.

segments.description: Karane looks down at herself, comparing her body to Hakari and Nano's voluptuous figures with a bitter frown.
segments.voiceover_text: Comparing her slender silhouette to Hakari and Nano's glamorous curves, crushing insecurity gnaws painfully at her fragile self-esteem.

segments.description: Karane bites her lip in quiet frustration, feeling like her tsundere outbursts make her unworthy of love.
segments.voiceover_text: She agonizes over her prickly, violent tsundere temper, terrified that Rentaro secretly wishes she was softer and more feminine.

segments.description: Karane hugs herself tighter, her eyes welling with quiet, lonely tears beneath her bangs.
segments.voiceover_text: A lonely chill settles over her soul, making her wonder if she truly belongs among Rentaro's breathtaking family of soulmates.

segments.description: Rentaro's footsteps approach and he quietly sits down right next to Karane, gazing at her with profound tenderness.
segments.voiceover_text: Suddenly, gentle footsteps approach as Rentaro quietly sits right beside her, gazing into her tearful eyes with pure devotion.
